notes: FOU-99 v1 Android — classifier + candidates from a 6-device bench campaign (Myron SD 8 Elite Gen 5, S23 SD 8 Gen 2, Klee Dim 8400, Tokay Tensor G4, Aether Helio G88, OnePlus 6 SD 845). SoC table revised: Tensor G3/G4 demoted to mid based on empirical CPU LLM TG measurements (Pixel 9 / Tensor G4 perf clusters with mid-class Snapdragon, not flagship). Candidates per tier derived from CPU-backend bench with tier-specific TG floors (low ≥5, mid ≥8, high ≥10, flagship ≥12) on representative tier devices.
_quant_policy: Within each tier, candidates are ORDERED — the first entry per model is the primary recommendation. For ≥3B models we prefer Q4_0 over Q4_K_M on Android: bench shows 10-15% TG advantage on CPU, lower peak memory at load (reducing OOM on 8 GiB devices), and Hexagon HTP delivers a 5× PP speedup on Q4_0 that does not apply to Q4_K_M. For sub-1B models the delta is within noise (~1 TG), so we keep Q4_K_M as primary for quality.

classifier._comment_layer_1: Layer 1: Build.SOC_MODEL (Android 12+ / API 31+). Case-insensitive exact match. This is the cleanest signal — covers ~80% of the active install base directly.
classifier._comment_layer_2: Layer 2: Build.HARDWARE codename — fallback for Android < 12. Seeded from Turso top-60 codenames. Some MTK k##### codenames need validation against bench (marked).
classifier._comment_layer_3: Layer 3: CPU heuristic — runs only when Layer 1+2 miss. Rules evaluated top-to-bottom, first match wins. Anchored on llama.cpp's actual dispatch signals (i8mm/dotprod) and on big-core clock as a thermal/silicon-class proxy.

rules.rationale: ARMv8.6+/v9 chips with i8mm are 2022+ flagship-class; llama.cpp uses i8mm kernels here
>= 3.0 GHz big-core sustained clock indicates flagship thermal/silicon class
ARMv8.2+ dotprod with capable clock = mid-range silicon
Has dotprod but lower clock — conservative mid (older big-A75/A76 phones)
Default — pre-ARMv8.2 chip, or unable to read CPU info

classifier._comment_matrix: Tier matrix: (ram_band × soc_class) → tier_id. Lookup unknowns: missing SoC class is treated as 'budget' for safety. Reported RAM ≪ nominal RAM (8 GiB phones report ~6.9-7.4 GiB; 12 GiB phones report ~10.3-11.3 GiB) — bands are tuned for reported values.

low.description: Entry tier — sub-1B models only. Bench anchors: Helio G88 / 6 GiB + SD 845 / 6-8 GiB. CPU TG floor: ≥5 tok/s. Even Bonsai-1.7B Q1_0 is borderline here (4.8 tok/s on SD 845, 3.2 on Helio G88).

mid.description: Mid tier — adds Bonsai-1.7B to the low set. Bench anchor: Pixel 9 / Tensor G4 (Tensor G3/G4 demoted from flagship to mid based on empirical CPU LLM perf clustering with mid Snapdragon). CPU TG floor: ≥8 tok/s.

high.description: High tier — adds SmolLM3-3B. Bench anchors: SD 8 Gen 2 / 8 GiB + Dim 8400 / 7.5 GiB. CPU TG floor: ≥10 tok/s. RAM ceiling ≈3.5 GB peak load — phi-4-mini Q4_K_M is borderline, 4B+ models below floor. SmolLM3-3B Q4_0 is primary (14.1 TG, lower peak mem); Q4_K_M is alternate (12.6 TG, marginal quality bump).

flagship.description: Flagship tier — adds 3-4B mid/q4 models. Bench anchor: POCO F8 Ultra / SD 8 Elite Gen 5 / 12 GiB. CPU TG floor: ≥12 tok/s. 8B+ models technically run but at <10 TG (slow) — excluded from defaults but loadable. Per _quant_policy, Q4_0 is primary for ≥3B models (Hex PP 5× speedup, lower load mem); Q4_K_M follows where measured.

_bench_campaign_notes.campaign: FOU-99 candidate validation, 2026-05-26 (revised 2026-06-01: Q4_0 primary for ≥3B, SmolLM3-3B Q4_0 added to flagship, Bonsai re-bench on v1.15.1 unlocked Bonsai-4B as flagship candidate; 2026-06-02: Aether closed out the re-bench, confirming no Q1_0 kernel speedup on memory-constrained low-tier devices)
devices_used: poco-myron (POCO F8 Ultra, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 / SM8850, 12 GiB)
pixel-9-tokay (Tensor G4, 12 GiB) — empirically mid-class on CPU LLM
redmi-aether (Helio G88 / MT6769V/CZ, 6 GiB) — budget anchor
oneplus6 (Snapdragon 845, ~6-8 GiB, Android 11) — old-flagship anchor; behaves as low/mid
key_findings: Tensor G3/G4 reclassified to mid (was flagship): empirical CPU TG ~half of Snapdragon flagship on identical cells.

Bonsai (Q1_0 1-bit) loads and runs in upstream llama.cpp (b9204+), but the kernel is slow-path: PP is 5-10x slower vs equivalent Q4_K_M, TG 2-4x slower. Footprint savings real (Bonsai-8B = 1.16 GB on disk vs Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M ~5 GB) but speed cost is significant.

Bonsai-4B Q1_0 newly crosses the flagship floor (≥8 TG) on v1.15.1 / llama.rn 0.12.4 — Myron 9.3 TG (was 7 TG on v1.15.0 / llama.rn 0.12.1, a ~33% speedup from the upstream Q1_0 kernel work). Added as a flagship candidate. S23/Klee/Tokay still below floor. On Aether (6 GiB low-tier Helio G88), the kernel improvement did NOT materialize — Bonsai-4B stayed at 1.61 TG (same as v1.15.0), suggesting the speedup needs compute/memory headroom to express.

Bonsai-8B Q1_0 loads on 8 GiB+ Android devices on v1.15.1 (S23 1.71 GiB peak, 2.9 TG) — earlier load-fail on v1.15.0 was a llama.cpp regression (upstream issue #22713) not a memory fundamental. Still below all tier floors — kept excluded. On 6 GiB Android (Aether), Bonsai-8B fails to load (OOM-killed) — Android lowmemorykiller is less permissive than iOS jetsam for the same peak (iPhone 13 Pro 6 GiB loads it fine).

Hexagon HTP supports Q1_0 dispatch but provides no acceleration AND adds dispatch overhead — Q1_0 TG is 5-26% LOWER on Hex than CPU on Bonsai. App should prefer CPU over Hex for Q1_0 specifically (opposite of Q4_0 where Hex gives 5x PP speedup).
Hexagon accelerates Q4_0 PP massively (phi-4-mini-reasoning Q4_0: CPU 47 → Hex 247) but not Q4_K_M.
S23 RAM ceiling ~3.5 GB peak load (8 GiB nominal / ~6.9 GiB reported); Klee similar at 7.5 GiB nominal. Phi-4-mini Q4_K_M borderline.
Helio G88 / 6 GiB device cannot reliably load 2+ GB peak models — recommend strictly sub-1B for safety.
excluded_from_recommendations: Bonsai-8B Q1_0 — TG below tier floors everywhere (Myron 4.1, S23 2.9, Klee 3.8, Tokay 2.7, OP6 0.67 on v1.15.1). Loads fine (1.71 GiB peak) but too slow.
Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M — fits Myron only (7 TG), below flagship floor
Gemma-4-E4B — Myron only at TG 10-11 (just below 12 floor); good candidate for v1.1 if floor relaxed
Phi-4-mini-reasoning Q4_K_M on high tier — borderline (S23 7.2, Klee 9.1 — below 10 floor); high tier ships Q4_0 only
v2_followups: Re-bench with the Gemma-4-E4B unlocked (it's right at the floor)
Add perf_class S/M/L hint to candidates once UX is defined
Backend-aware overlay: Hex Q4_0 acceleration is a real perf win on phi-4-mini-reasoning that we leave on the table in CPU-only v1
